# Video Inpainting — RunComfy Pro Pack

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — mask-driven video region editing: replace an object or restyle a masked region inside an existing clip with temporal coherence across frames. Documents the mask-first workflow (binary mask required, first-frame anchoring), the temporal-consistency recipe, and when mask editing beats prompt-only video edit routes. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @genmedia-labs. Honest caveats: paid RunComfy account, billed per generation; you must supply a binary mask up front — no mask, no edit; heavy masks over long clips cost more and can drift at the edges.
